project_updates.title: Boundary and chronology reconciled
project_updates.notes: IM3 record 00300974499 maps one 1,338,261-square-foot building footprint. The Maricopa assessor instead describes a 1,255,156-square-foot Computer Center improvement on parcel 304-33-005S; Mesa permits often describe a roughly 1.3-million-square-foot converted facility, data halls and central plant, but do not crosswalk those components to the IM3 outline. Apple operator reports were checked from 2015-2026 and establish operational control in October 2015, conversion from the failed predecessor manufacturing use, and customer service beginning March 2017. The selected-building account therefore retains facility and campus facts as unallocated and keeps Platypus-owned real property, Apple-owned personal property, later permit phases, off-site Bonnybrooke generation, statewide renewable projects and other Apple facilities distinct.
project_updates.project_description: Apple Mesa is a converted and expanded data-center facility at 3740 South Signal Butte Road in Mesa, Arizona. Apple took operational control in October 2015, and the site began serving customers in March 2017; the account keeps the real-estate parcel, Apple-owned equipment, later data-hall permits, renewable-energy support, and facility electricity reporting distinct.

project_updates.title: Operator and predecessor materials separate conversion from expansion
project_updates.notes: Apple environmental reports for 2015-2026, Apple newsroom releases, Mesa economic-development minutes, assessor ownership and the permit chronology were searched for Apple, Platypus Development LLC, GT Advanced Technologies, First Solar, 3740 S Signal Butte, global command center, data center, Data Halls A and B, integration and MSC91. They establish a reused former manufacturing shell, Apple control in October 2015, 2016 conversion work, March 2017 service, later data-hall fit-outs and 2019 onsite solar. First Solar, GT Advanced and pre-control permit costs are excluded from Apple investment; later Apple permits remain separately dated rather than being backcast to the opening.

project_updates.title: Assessor, parcel and exemption records retain account boundaries
project_updates.notes: Maricopa Assessor searches used parcel 304-33-005S, business-personal-property account 9372704/993-72-704, Apple Inc., Platypus Development LLC and 3740 S Signal Butte for tax years 2016-2027. The real parcel and Apple BPP account remain separate; 2023-2026 full cash and assessed values are already retained, the real parcel is legal class 6.2 FOREIGN TRADE ZONES at a 5% ratio, and the BPP assessed value equals 5% of full cash value. The 2027 values are future to review and excluded. No public assessor record supplies a no-FTZ counterfactual value, exemption cash receipt, appeal result or building-level allocation.

project_updates.title: Tax bills and payments verified through the latest posted year
project_updates.notes: The Maricopa Treasurer portal was reviewed interactively for BPP account 993-72-704 and real-property parcel 304-33-005S across tax years 2016-2026. Billed and paid amounts through 2025 are already retained separately for each account; the BPP 2025 receipt shows $966,899.82 paid and a distribution chart, while no 2026 tax bill was posted as of September 6, 2026. The portal did not disclose an official Class 1 counterfactual bill, cash value of the FTZ preference, IOC utility-tax relief, separate permit-fee receipt or marginal service cost. Absence of a 2026 bill is a timing gap, not zero liability.

project_updates.title: Mesa permit dataset reconciled exhaustively at the address
project_updates.notes: The City of Mesa Socrata endpoint was queried for exact address 3740 S SIGNAL BUTTE RD with a 500-row limit and returned 212 records spanning 2011-2026. Every row was reviewed by permit number, description, issue/final date, status, valuation, invoiced fee, contractor and locality. Thirty-two Apple-era records issued in 2016 or later had a positive valuation and terminal Finaled, C of O Issued or C of C Issued status: eight were already retained and twenty-four omitted records are added here. Their administrative valuations total $209,312,213.34 across separate and sometimes overlapping permits and are deliberately not published as an additive total. Fourteen completed records report $343,013.61 in total invoiced fees, including existing and newly added permits; those fees remain in this audit trail because no global permit-fee metric exists. PMT18-04958 documents two six-inch water meters but reports zero valuation; open, issued-only, fees-due, under-review and revisions-required rows—including BLD2016-07806, BLD2017-00332, BLD2017-03416, PMT26-07994, PMT26-12780 and PMT26-13495—are not treated as completed investment. Pre-Apple manufacturing and transition permits are excluded. Contractor cities identify office addresses only, not contract payment, local ownership, subcontractors, worker residence or local spend.

project_updates.title: Planning, zoning, FTZ agreement and fee obligations remain non-cash records
project_updates.notes: Mesa Legistar, the meeting archive, planning and pre-submittal indexes were searched for Apple, Platypus, 3740 S Signal Butte, FTZ 221, Resolution 12520, 26-0446, data center, command center and MSC91 from 2014-2026. File 26-0446 and the May 18, 2026 final agenda identify proposed approval of an Apple FTZ operator agreement for the address; the agreement schedules a $1,000 activation fee and $5,000 annual administrative fee, but the posted execution blocks are blank and the meeting minutes remained draft. No payment is claimed. A September 8, 2026 MSC91 pre-submittal listing falls after this review date and is excluded. No separately valued grading, land-disturbance, stormwater or operating permit crosswalk was found beyond the reconciled Socrata records.

project_updates.title: Incentive, compliance and audit records do not disclose realized relief
project_updates.notes: Arizona Commerce Authority IOC program reports, the FY2025 annual report, JLBC tax-credit review, Arizona Department of Revenue assessment-ratio material, FTZ Board records and Mesa agreement documents were searched for Apple and the Mesa facility through FY2025. ACA lists Apple as post-approved with a $100 million-plus FY2025 statutory qualifying amount, but expressly says it may include carryover and actual investment is confidential; no new capital record is created. The sources disclose eligibility rules, a prior $25 million state forecast and property classification but no Apple IOC utility-tax relief, transaction-privilege-tax exemption, credit claimed, refund, FTZ duty avoided, grant payment or jurisdiction-level forgone revenue. A forecast midpoint cannot substitute for realization.

project_updates.title: Budgets, audits, ACFRs and financial reports close no public-cost gap
project_updates.notes: City of Mesa ACFRs, single audits, adopted budgets, monthly and quarterly financial-status reports, accounting access and meeting materials were searched for fiscal years 2015-2025 using Apple, Platypus Development, Signal Butte, data center, FTZ, IOC, abatement, grant, infrastructure, tax and check-register terms. No Apple-specific public infrastructure outlay, reimbursement, grant payment, bond or IRB proceeds, TIF or PILOT, waived impact fee, service-cost allocation, check-register disbursement or net fiscal analysis was disclosed. General city and utility capital projects near Signal Butte cannot be assigned to Apple without a beneficiary and funding crosswalk. Negative results preserve gaps rather than zero public cost.

project_updates.title: Water and wastewater pathways are direct, quantities remain undisclosed
project_updates.notes: The Apple Mesa AWS certification report, Apple environmental reports for 2018-2026, Mesa water and wastewater planning and rate materials, Greenfield Water Reclamation Plant references, permit records and operator water announcements were reviewed. The AWS audit identifies City of Mesa water supplied from the Signal Butte Water Treatment Plant using CAP/Colorado River water and wastewater sent to Greenfield for treatment, agriculture and recharge. It says the internal water balance and annual variance were quantified, but publishes no values, notes unresolved loss and metering work, and says most effluent is cooling-tower blowdown with domestic sewage below 5%. PMT18-04958 confirms two six-inch meters but no readings or bills. Apple reports implementation of treatment improvements but no Mesa-specific realized savings. Direct annual withdrawal, consumption, discharge, charges and payments remain records-request gaps; electricity-to-WUE conversion is not a substitute.

project_updates.title: Electricity, generation, tariff and infrastructure scopes remain separated
project_updates.notes: Apple environmental reports, SRP's 2019 Blue Book and 2025 official statement, SRP tariff and public-infrastructure materials, and EIA-860/923 access were searched for Mesa, Apple, Bonnybrooke, Mesa Carport PV, plant 64404, utility/operator 57369, substation, transmission, natural gas and backup generation. Apple facility electricity use for 2017-2025 remains direct operator evidence. SRP reports the off-site Apple Bonnybrooke resource at 52 MW and 117,124 MWh net production, while Apple reports a nominal 50 MW support project and 4.67 MW onsite solar; these differently defined capacity facts are not forced into one number. Neither source provides the facility's SRP tariff determinants, peak demand, bill, payment, interconnection contribution or natural-gas use. Plant output is not facility load, and a statewide sector price is not the Apple bill.

project_updates.title: Environmental and generator searches yield no operational quantity
project_updates.notes: Maricopa County Air Quality facility, permit, equipment, emissions and compliance portals, ADEQ hazardous-waste and water indexes, EPA ECHO/FRS access and exact web searches were run for Apple Inc., Platypus Development LLC, GT Advanced Technologies, First Solar, 3740 S Signal Butte and parcel 304-33-005S from 2011-2026. Pre-Apple GT Advanced and First Solar records were not reassigned. No attributable Apple record disclosed emergency-generator count or capacity, runtime, diesel or gas use, actual emissions, discharge exceedance, inspection result, violation, penalty or payment. Permit BLD2016-03847 only values a generator-yard fire alarm; it does not quantify generators or emissions. County or eGRID averages cannot establish site emissions.

project_updates.title: Workforce, payroll, occupation and residence evidence remains incomplete
project_updates.notes: Apple careers and role pages, Arizona workforce and occupation access, Mesa economic-development minutes, FTZ annual reports, Census County Business Patterns and BLS QCEW/OEWS were searched for Apple Mesa, data center operations, critical facilities, logistics, integration, employees, jobs, wages, payroll, residence, apprenticeship and training from 2015-2026. Current 40-hour Mesa vacancies confirm occupations sought, not filled positions. The 2015 operating-job and construction-worker forecasts remain projections; FTZ 221's 101-150 employment band is zone-wide and includes another operator. No source reports actual Apple facility headcount, employee/contractor split, annual-average FTE, payroll, benefits, occupation mix, worker residence, construction job-years or hires. Zone acreage and county industry averages cannot repair those gaps.

project_updates.title: Entity, contractor, supplier and procurement searches identify roles, not payments
project_updates.notes: Maricopa Recorder, Arizona entity access, Mesa permits, meeting files and direct searches used Apple Inc., Platypus Development LLC, GT Advanced Technologies, First Solar, Mortenson, Holder, Hunt, Southland, Nexus Alarm, DWL Architects and permit numbers for 2011-2026. The permit dataset identifies contractors and Arizona office cities for some scopes, but no contract value, invoice, payment date, subcontractor roster, supplier production geography, local-purchase share, payroll or lien payment was disclosed. Recorder results did not establish a selected-building acquisition consideration or supplier payment. Permit valuation is not procurement spending, and an Arizona office address is not evidence of local ownership or Maricopa production.

project_updates.title: Community and recipient-side searches retain no attributable cash amount
project_updates.notes: Apple newsroom, environmental reports, Mesa agendas and minutes, local school and nonprofit web results, SRP partnership material and direct recipient searches were reviewed for Mesa, Apple, data center, education, grant, donation, sponsorship, watershed, forest restoration and recipient names from 2015-2026. Apple describes regional Colorado River Basin and Greater Phoenix water-restoration projects and national programs, but publishes modeled future water benefits rather than a Mesa-facility cash payment or recipient receipt. No recipient-side record disclosed an exact Apple Mesa donation, payment date, restriction or project attribution. Regional partnership activity is not assigned to the selected building and the unresolved amount remains a gap, not zero community contribution.

project_updates.title: County GDP, employment and wage comparisons fail causal prerequisites
project_updates.notes: BLS QCEW downloadable county totals and industry detail, BEA county GDP and earnings, Census County Business Patterns and workforce access were checked for Maricopa County through the latest complete annual vintages. The selected conversion has October 2015 control, 2016 conversion milestones and March 2017 service, while other county data centers and broad regional growth create overlapping treatments. No comparison county, validated parallel trend, facility treatment share, worker-residence bridge or control for simultaneous development was established. Aggregate before-after percentage gaps are descriptive composition changes, not Apple contributions, and all three legacy county-outcome models are removed rather than relabeled as impacts.

project_updates.title: All 27 legacy models individually adjudicated under policy 1.3.0
project_updates.notes: Retain: none. Revise and supersede: est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2023 -> est_study_apple_mesa_bpp_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2023; est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2024 -> est_study_apple_mesa_bpp_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2024; est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2025 -> est_study_apple_mesa_bpp_ftz_property_tax_reduction_2025. The replacements use only the Apple BPP account, whose 5% assessed ratio is directly observed, and no longer apply the ratio scaling to the differently valued real-property account. Remove: est_study_apple_mesa_onsite_water_2025 (no published site water quantity); est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_employment_2024 (zone-wide band includes another operator); est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_payroll_2024 (inherits zone employment and county wage mismatch); est_study_apple_mesa_ioc_credit_realized (forecast midpoint is not realization); est_study_apple_mesa_ftz_export_duty_avoidance_2024 (no product, foreign-status share or duty inputs); est_study_apple_mesa_allocated_employment_2024 (acreage is not employment allocation); est_study_apple_mesa_allocated_payroll_2024 (inherits invalid acreage allocation and generic wage); est_study_apple_mesa_electricity_cost_2025 (sector benchmark is not the SRP bill); est_study_apple_mesa_location_emissions_2025 (regional factor is not site generation or market-based emissions); est_study_apple_mesa_cooling_water_savings_potential_2025 (inherits unsupported water use and transferred savings rate); est_study_full_apple_mesa_annualized_capital (assumed six-year profile); est_study_full_apple_mesa_local_construction_spend (unsupported construction and local shares); est_study_full_apple_mesa_construction_job_years_total and est_study_full_apple_mesa_construction_labor_income_total (transferred input-output coefficients without direct spend or time profile); est_study_full_apple_mesa_operating_fte_total, est_study_full_apple_mesa_operating_labor_income_total and est_study_full_apple_mesa_operating_supplier_output (unobserved base employment and transferred coefficients); est_study_full_apple_mesa_household_output (inherits unsupported operating chain); est_study_full_apple_mesa_latest_local_tax_contribution (restates two direct tax observations as a model); est_study_full_apple_mesa_annual_local_service_cost_break_even (tautological threshold without service-cost evidence); est_study_full_apple_mesa_wastewater (inherits unsupported water and arbitrary discharge share); est_study_full_apple_mesa_employment_comparison_gap, est_study_full_apple_mesa_gdp_comparison_gap and est_study_full_apple_mesa_wage_comparison_gap (no defensible treatment, comparator or causal diagnostics). Exact tally: 0 retain, 3 revise, 24 remove. The legacy base is append-only at worker scope, so these IDs are explicit orchestration removal directives; only the three replacement estimates are added to the scoped synthesis fragment.
